stem: While reconciling pharmacy records, a pharmacy designs its patient-counseling workflow. Select all supported principles.

choices.text: In this setting, provide the meaningful counseling opportunity required by 247 CMR 9.18.
Given the described event, treat a receipt signature as proof of adequate counseling in every case.
On this record, delegate counseling to an unlicensed cashier.
At this stage, use pharmacist judgment and patient-specific information rather than a purely mechanical signature.
For this scenario, omit counseling whenever a drug has a Medication Guide.
